# Koi StyleKit

Open-source illustration prompt tool with 308 recipes: 48 families and 260 variants.
开源插画提示词工具：308 项配方，包含 48 个家族与 260 个变体。

## Uses and workflow
Article/social covers, conceptual product/website illustrations, and course illustrations.
Browse samples → select a style → enter a subject and purpose → resolve palette conflicts → export a Chinese prompt or JSON → use your own image-generation tool.
The static gallery runs in a browser without installation. Python CLI and Agent Skill are also available.

## Readable resources
- [Gallery and usage questions](./index.html)
- [Catalogue data](./styles.json)

- [English documentation](https://github.com/koi-lee/koi-stylekit/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [Agent Skill](https://github.com/koi-lee/koi-stylekit/blob/main/SKILL.md)

## Boundaries
No automatic image generation, AI API, account, or telemetry. Subjects stay in browser memory; favorites are local to that browser and origin.
Samples are candidates, not proof of repeatable cross-topic/model results. Consistent characters and strict brand colors are not guaranteed.
Chinese interface and prompt output. Documentation in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish does not mean a five-language UI.
This file is a supplementary resource index, not a search-indexing or AI-citation guarantee.
